## VariablesAPI — figma.variables (L2016)


**VariableCollection (L10418):** `name`, `modes`, `variableIds`, `defaultModeId`, `hiddenFromPublishing`

- `addMode(name)` → `modeId`; `removeMode(modeId)`; `renameMode(modeId, name)`
